svg.text: D · The Set — how it looks and feels · 8 frames
Phones 1:1 inside browser chrome (714 px usable). Stays textual until an item opens. Revision clouds drawn from a real pixel diff of FOLD-A v1 → v1.1. D-codes illustrative; counts approximate.
A title block (ruled 1.2 px ink), then revisions (3 rows), then the
index collapsed to stages: one row each, a count, a Δ count. No
Δ = changed since you last looked. Plain triangle, no issue
number (see push: issues are by day, not per publish).
Lock row carries the 3 px ‘now’ bar. Future stages in ink 2.
One input: ‘Go to’ a code. A register earns a search field; it's the

the register's way to compare. The table rows are the A/B switch:

Path: Records (1) → Decisions (2) → the row → a code (3).
Decisions are a register too: date · his words verbatim · the codes
it caused. 45 rows today, newest first; this one is a scan away.
